tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Professor
professor.text: Should schools teach personal finance to prepare students for future money management? Explain your opinion clearly.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I think schools should teach personal finance because students need to know how to budget and save before they become independent.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I agree it is useful, but schools already have many required subjects, so I worry that finance lessons might take time away from academic courses.
